decisions:
- id: D1
  text: Parcel weight must not exceed 25000 g; heavier parcels are rejected with 422 WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight must be between 25001 g and 1000000 g inclusive; outside this range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight band: A ≤ 5000 g, B = 5001–15000 g, C = 15001–25000 g; mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (E.164 UK mobile); other formats return 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Address country must be GB; any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Postcode must match UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ and its outward code must match the city; mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Idempotency-Key header is optional (max 255 chars); when provided, repeated key with same payload returns the original shipment (201) with Idempotent-Replayed: true; blank or missing key always creates a new shipment.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Webhook event shipment.status_changed is emitted on every status change (CREATED→COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED→RETURNED) with occurred_at in ISO 8601 UTC; payload includes event, shipment_id, reference, status, occurred_at.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}; consumer must verify and respond 2xx for valid, 401 for invalid/missing signature.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: 'Unknown fields in request body are rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST (additionalProperties: false on all request schemas).'
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Missing or invalid Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Shipment status values are exactly CREATED, COLLECTED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED; no other statuses exist.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers as raw customer input (e.g. '07700 900200', '+447700900200', '0044 7700-900200'). The consumer will normalize to E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX before sending to Parcelly.
  owner: consumer
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores the whole delivery address in one free-text field 'address_line' (UK postcode last after city). The consumer will parse it into Parcelly's structured address (street, building, postcode, city, country=GB). Incomplete addresses (missing building/postcode) will be sent as-is; Parcelly's warehouse calls the customer before shipping.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes order weight_kg is a float (sum of unit_weight_kg × quantity, 3 decimals). The consumer will convert to parcel weight_g (int grams, rounded) and choose size band: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001–15000g, C 15001–25000g. Orders over 25 kg (e.g. cargo bikes) never fit standard parcels; the consumer will not call create_shipment for them (manual warehouse process).'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Idempotency: Spokes ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS are called on every payment confirmation (gateways may retry). The consumer will use the Spokes order_id (format ORD-<number>) as the Idempotency-Key when calling create_shipment. This ensures repeated payment confirmations for the same order produce only one shipment.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: Spokes order items (sku, name, quantity, unit_price_pence) are not sent to Parcelly; Parcelly's shipment API has no items field. The consumer keeps items only in Spokes for order management and invoicing.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "Cargo bikes (e.g. Spokes Haul 2 at 27 kg, 31.5 kg with front rack) exceed the 25 kg parcel limit. The internal rule says they 'never fit standard courier parcels' and warehouse handles them manually. Should the integration simply skip create_shipment for orders where total weight_kg > 25, leaving them for manual warehouse processing? Answer: Skip create_shipment for weight_kg > 25; order stays paid, warehouse handles manually"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "Spokes address_line is a single free-text field. Parsing it into street/building/postcode/city reliably is hard (examples: 'Flat 3, 5 Long Street, London E1 6AN', 'Unit 5, 84-92 Oxford Street, London W1D 1BS', 'Behind the old mill, London'). What parsing strategy should the consumer use? Answer: Best-effort regex: extract UK postcode (last), city (before postcode), rest as street; building/flat from known patterns (Flat X, Unit X, Apt X). Send what we parse; Parcelly warehouse calls customer if incomplete."
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D18
  text: Parcel shipments require a valid UK postcode in the receiver address; requests without a matching postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D19
  text: Parcel shipments are limited to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier orders must use the pallet service (create_pallet) with weight_g 25001–1000000 and pallet_type=EUR.
  owner: provider
- id: H3
  text: "Redacted: request for clarification on postcode requirement Answer: Consumer fixes S3: add a valid postcode to the address_line (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London E1 6AN') and expect 201"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: 'Redacted: request for clarification on weight limit handling Answer: Consumer changes S2 weight_kg to ≤25 (e.g., 1.5) for parcel idempotency test'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D20
  text: Parcelly Address schema requires postcode with UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; requests without a valid postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D21
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D22
  text: Receiver address must include a postcode matching UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; Parcelly rejects requests without it with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D23
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D24
  text: Consumer scenarios that emit shipment_status_changed webhooks must capture shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via find_shipment or test binding capture) before emitting.
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: Contract must include at least one end-to-end scenario covering paid order → shipment creation → status webhooks → consumer order update.
  owner: provider

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 11
status: proposed
parties:

environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  shipment: A parcel or pallet delivery created by a partner order reference
  parcel: Standard courier parcel (service=parcel) with weight up to 25 kg and size A/B/C
  pallet: Euro pallet shipment (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR) weighing 25.001–1000 kg
  tracking_number: 'Carrier tracking code: PCL<n>GB for parcels, PAL<n>GB for pallets'
  price_pence: Shipment price in pence (integer, 100 pence = £1)
  idempotency_key: Header value (max 255 chars) that makes shipment creation idempotent; blank or absent creates a new shipment
  webhook_secret: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads; header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:

    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country

    properties:

        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:

    - phone

    properties:

    required:

  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:

    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:

    required:

      events:

        items:

  ShipmentStatusChanged:

    required:

    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:

        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:

      occurred_at:

        format: date-time

        receiver:

webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:

          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  parcelly_status_to_spokes_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    DELIVERED: delivered
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: Parcel weight must not exceed 25000 g; heavier parcels are rejected with 422 WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight must be between 25001 g and 1000000 g inclusive; outside this range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight band: A ≤ 5000 g, B = 5001–15000 g, C = 15001–25000 g; mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (E.164 UK mobile); other formats return 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Address country must be GB; any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Postcode must match UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ and its outward code must match the city; mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Idempotency-Key header is optional (max 255 chars); when provided, repeated key with same payload returns the original shipment (201) with Idempotent-Replayed: true; blank or missing key always creates a new shipment.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Webhook event shipment.status_changed is emitted on every status change (CREATED→COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED→RETURNED) with occurred_at in ISO 8601 UTC; payload includes event, shipment_id, reference, status, occurred_at.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}; consumer must verify and respond 2xx for valid, 401 for invalid/missing signature.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: 'Unknown fields in request body are rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST (additionalProperties: false on all request schemas).'
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Missing or invalid Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Shipment status values are exactly CREATED, COLLECTED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED; no other statuses exist.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers as raw customer input (e.g. '07700 900200', '+447700900200', '0044 7700-900200'). The consumer will normalize to E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX before sending to Parcelly.
  owner: consumer
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores the whole delivery address in one free-text field 'address_line' (UK postcode last after city). The consumer will parse it into Parcelly's structured address (street, building, postcode, city, country=GB). Incomplete addresses (missing building/postcode) will be sent as-is; Parcelly's warehouse calls the customer before shipping.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes order weight_kg is a float (sum of unit_weight_kg × quantity, 3 decimals). The consumer will convert to parcel weight_g (int grams, rounded) and choose size band: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001–15000g, C 15001–25000g. Orders over 25 kg (e.g. cargo bikes) never fit standard parcels; the consumer will not call create_shipment for them (manual warehouse process).'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Idempotency: Spokes ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS are called on every payment confirmation (gateways may retry). The consumer will use the Spokes order_id (format ORD-<number>) as the Idempotency-Key when calling create_shipment. This ensures repeated payment confirmations for the same order produce only one shipment.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: Spokes order items (sku, name, quantity, unit_price_pence) are not sent to Parcelly; Parcelly's shipment API has no items field. The consumer keeps items only in Spokes for order management and invoicing.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "Cargo bikes (e.g. Spokes Haul 2 at 27 kg, 31.5 kg with front rack) exceed the 25 kg parcel limit. The internal rule says they 'never fit standard courier parcels' and warehouse handles them manually. Should the integration simply skip create_shipment for orders where total weight_kg > 25, leaving them for manual warehouse processing? Answer: Skip create_shipment for weight_kg > 25; order stays paid, warehouse handles manually"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "Spokes address_line is a single free-text field. Parsing it into street/building/postcode/city reliably is hard (examples: 'Flat 3, 5 Long Street, London E1 6AN', 'Unit 5, 84-92 Oxford Street, London W1D 1BS', 'Behind the old mill, London'). What parsing strategy should the consumer use? Answer: Best-effort regex: extract UK postcode (last), city (before postcode), rest as street; building/flat from known patterns (Flat X, Unit X, Apt X). Send what we parse; Parcelly warehouse calls customer if incomplete."
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D18
  text: Parcel shipments require a valid UK postcode in the receiver address; requests without a matching postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D19
  text: Parcel shipments are limited to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier orders must use the pallet service (create_pallet) with weight_g 25001–1000000 and pallet_type=EUR.
  owner: provider
- id: H3
  text: "Redacted: request for clarification on postcode requirement Answer: Consumer fixes S3: add a valid postcode to the address_line (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London E1 6AN') and expect 201"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: 'Redacted: request for clarification on weight limit handling Answer: Consumer changes S2 weight_kg to ≤25 (e.g., 1.5) for parcel idempotency test'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D20
  text: Parcelly Address schema requires postcode with UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; requests without a valid postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D21
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D22
  text: Receiver address must include a postcode matching UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; Parcelly rejects requests without it with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D23
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D24
  text: Consumer scenarios that emit shipment_status_changed webhooks must capture shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via find_shipment or test binding capture) before emitting.
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: Contract must include at least one end-to-end scenario covering paid order → shipment creation → status webhooks → consumer order update.
  owner: provider
- id: D26
  text: The consumer must ensure a valid UK postcode is provided in receiver.address.postcode for every create_shipment request; otherwise Parcelly rejects with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: consumer
- id: D27
  text: Parcel shipments via create_shipment are limited to weight_g <= 25000; heavier shipments must use create_pallet with service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000.
  owner: consumer
- id: D28
  text: The consumer's webhook handlers must capture the shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via expect_received capture) to reference in subsequent webhook emissions.
  owner: consumer
- id: D29
  text: The consumer's address parsing must map the free-text address_line to Parcelly's Address schema fields (street, building, flat, postcode, city, country) such that building is a building identifier and flat is the unit/flat number.
  owner: consumer

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 12
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  shipment: A parcel or pallet delivery created by a partner order reference
  parcel: Standard courier parcel (service=parcel) with weight up to 25 kg and size A/B/C
  pallet: Euro pallet shipment (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR) weighing 25.001–1000 kg
  tracking_number: 'Carrier tracking code: PCL<n>GB for parcels, PAL<n>GB for pallets'
  price_pence: Shipment price in pence (integer, 100 pence = £1)
  idempotency_key: Header value (max 255 chars) that makes shipment creation idempotent; blank or absent creates a new shipment
  webhook_secret: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads; header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreateShipmentRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB

        receiver:

          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            flat: '3'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      idempotent_on_header: Idempotency-Key
  find_shipment:
    description: Most recent shipment with a reference
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':

      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: IN_TRANSIT
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith

          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'

        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T11:00:00.000Z'
  get_shipment:
    description: One shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments/{id}
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true

    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: DELIVERED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'

            city: London

    CREATED: paid

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: Parcel weight must not exceed 25000 g; heavier parcels are rejected with 422 WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight must be between 25001 g and 1000000 g inclusive; outside this range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight band: A ≤ 5000 g, B = 5001–15000 g, C = 15001–25000 g; mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (E.164 UK mobile); other formats return 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Address country must be GB; any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Postcode must match UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ and its outward code must match the city; mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Idempotency-Key header is optional (max 255 chars); when provided, repeated key with same payload returns the original shipment (201) with Idempotent-Replayed: true; blank or missing key always creates a new shipment.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Webhook event shipment.status_changed is emitted on every status change (CREATED→COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED→RETURNED) with occurred_at in ISO 8601 UTC; payload includes event, shipment_id, reference, status, occurred_at.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}; consumer must verify and respond 2xx for valid, 401 for invalid/missing signature.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: 'Unknown fields in request body are rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST (additionalProperties: false on all request schemas).'
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Missing or invalid Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Shipment status values are exactly CREATED, COLLECTED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED; no other statuses exist.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers as raw customer input (e.g. '07700 900200', '+447700900200', '0044 7700-900200'). The consumer will normalize to E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX before sending to Parcelly.
  owner: consumer
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores the whole delivery address in one free-text field 'address_line' (UK postcode last after city). The consumer will parse it into Parcelly's structured address (street, building, postcode, city, country=GB). Incomplete addresses (missing building/postcode) will be sent as-is; Parcelly's warehouse calls the customer before shipping.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes order weight_kg is a float (sum of unit_weight_kg × quantity, 3 decimals). The consumer will convert to parcel weight_g (int grams, rounded) and choose size band: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001–15000g, C 15001–25000g. Orders over 25 kg (e.g. cargo bikes) never fit standard parcels; the consumer will not call create_shipment for them (manual warehouse process).'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Idempotency: Spokes ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS are called on every payment confirmation (gateways may retry). The consumer will use the Spokes order_id (format ORD-<number>) as the Idempotency-Key when calling create_shipment. This ensures repeated payment confirmations for the same order produce only one shipment.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: Spokes order items (sku, name, quantity, unit_price_pence) are not sent to Parcelly; Parcelly's shipment API has no items field. The consumer keeps items only in Spokes for order management and invoicing.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "Cargo bikes (e.g. Spokes Haul 2 at 27 kg, 31.5 kg with front rack) exceed the 25 kg parcel limit. The internal rule says they 'never fit standard courier parcels' and warehouse handles them manually. Should the integration simply skip create_shipment for orders where total weight_kg > 25, leaving them for manual warehouse processing? Answer: Skip create_shipment for weight_kg > 25; order stays paid, warehouse handles manually"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "Spokes address_line is a single free-text field. Parsing it into street/building/postcode/city reliably is hard (examples: 'Flat 3, 5 Long Street, London E1 6AN', 'Unit 5, 84-92 Oxford Street, London W1D 1BS', 'Behind the old mill, London'). What parsing strategy should the consumer use? Answer: Best-effort regex: extract UK postcode (last), city (before postcode), rest as street; building/flat from known patterns (Flat X, Unit X, Apt X). Send what we parse; Parcelly warehouse calls customer if incomplete."
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D18
  text: Parcel shipments require a valid UK postcode in the receiver address; requests without a matching postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D19
  text: Parcel shipments are limited to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier orders must use the pallet service (create_pallet) with weight_g 25001–1000000 and pallet_type=EUR.
  owner: provider
- id: H3
  text: "Redacted: request for clarification on postcode requirement Answer: Consumer fixes S3: add a valid postcode to the address_line (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London E1 6AN') and expect 201"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: 'Redacted: request for clarification on weight limit handling Answer: Consumer changes S2 weight_kg to ≤25 (e.g., 1.5) for parcel idempotency test'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D20
  text: Parcelly Address schema requires postcode with UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; requests without a valid postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D21
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D22
  text: Receiver address must include a postcode matching UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; Parcelly rejects requests without it with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D23
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D24
  text: Consumer scenarios that emit shipment_status_changed webhooks must capture shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via find_shipment or test binding capture) before emitting.
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: Contract must include at least one end-to-end scenario covering paid order → shipment creation → status webhooks → consumer order update.
  owner: provider
- id: D26
  text: The consumer must ensure a valid UK postcode is provided in receiver.address.postcode for every create_shipment request; otherwise Parcelly rejects with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: consumer
- id: D27
  text: Parcel shipments via create_shipment are limited to weight_g <= 25000; heavier shipments must use create_pallet with service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000.
  owner: consumer
- id: D28
  text: The consumer's webhook handlers must capture the shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via expect_received capture) to reference in subsequent webhook emissions.
  owner: consumer
- id: D29
  text: The consumer's address parsing must map the free-text address_line to Parcelly's Address schema fields (street, building, flat, postcode, city, country) such that building is a building identifier and flat is the unit/flat number.
  owner: consumer

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: Parcel weight must not exceed 25000 g; heavier parcels are rejected with 422 WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight must be between 25001 g and 1000000 g inclusive; outside this range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight band: A ≤ 5000 g, B = 5001–15000 g, C = 15001–25000 g; mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (E.164 UK mobile); other formats return 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Address country must be GB; any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Postcode must match UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ and its outward code must match the city; mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Idempotency-Key header is optional (max 255 chars); when provided, repeated key with same payload returns the original shipment (201) with Idempotent-Replayed: true; blank or missing key always creates a new shipment.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Webhook event shipment.status_changed is emitted on every status change (CREATED→COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED→RETURNED) with occurred_at in ISO 8601 UTC; payload includes event, shipment_id, reference, status, occurred_at.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}; consumer must verify and respond 2xx for valid, 401 for invalid/missing signature.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: 'Unknown fields in request body are rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST (additionalProperties: false on all request schemas).'
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Missing or invalid Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Shipment status values are exactly CREATED, COLLECTED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED; no other statuses exist.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers as raw customer input (e.g. '07700 900200', '+447700900200', '0044 7700-900200'). The consumer will normalize to E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX before sending to Parcelly.
  owner: consumer
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores the whole delivery address in one free-text field 'address_line' (UK postcode last after city). The consumer will parse it into Parcelly's structured address (street, building, postcode, city, country=GB). Incomplete addresses (missing building/postcode) will be sent as-is; Parcelly's warehouse calls the customer before shipping.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes order weight_kg is a float (sum of unit_weight_kg × quantity, 3 decimals). The consumer will convert to parcel weight_g (int grams, rounded) and choose size band: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001–15000g, C 15001–25000g. Orders over 25 kg (e.g. cargo bikes) never fit standard parcels; the consumer will not call create_shipment for them (manual warehouse process).'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Idempotency: Spokes ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS are called on every payment confirmation (gateways may retry). The consumer will use the Spokes order_id (format ORD-<number>) as the Idempotency-Key when calling create_shipment. This ensures repeated payment confirmations for the same order produce only one shipment.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: Spokes order items (sku, name, quantity, unit_price_pence) are not sent to Parcelly; Parcelly's shipment API has no items field. The consumer keeps items only in Spokes for order management and invoicing.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "Cargo bikes (e.g. Spokes Haul 2 at 27 kg, 31.5 kg with front rack) exceed the 25 kg parcel limit. The internal rule says they 'never fit standard courier parcels' and warehouse handles them manually. Should the integration simply skip create_shipment for orders where total weight_kg > 25, leaving them for manual warehouse processing? Answer: Skip create_shipment for weight_kg > 25; order stays paid, warehouse handles manually"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "Spokes address_line is a single free-text field. Parsing it into street/building/postcode/city reliably is hard (examples: 'Flat 3, 5 Long Street, London E1 6AN', 'Unit 5, 84-92 Oxford Street, London W1D 1BS', 'Behind the old mill, London'). What parsing strategy should the consumer use? Answer: Best-effort regex: extract UK postcode (last), city (before postcode), rest as street; building/flat from known patterns (Flat X, Unit X, Apt X). Send what we parse; Parcelly warehouse calls customer if incomplete."
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D18
  text: Parcel shipments require a valid UK postcode in the receiver address; requests without a matching postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D19
  text: Parcel shipments are limited to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier orders must use the pallet service (create_pallet) with weight_g 25001–1000000 and pallet_type=EUR.
  owner: provider
- id: H3
  text: "Redacted: request for clarification on postcode requirement Answer: Consumer fixes S3: add a valid postcode to the address_line (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London E1 6AN') and expect 201"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: 'Redacted: request for clarification on weight limit handling Answer: Consumer changes S2 weight_kg to ≤25 (e.g., 1.5) for parcel idempotency test'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D20
  text: Parcelly Address schema requires postcode with UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; requests without a valid postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D21
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D22
  text: Receiver address must include a postcode matching UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; Parcelly rejects requests without it with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D23
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D24
  text: Consumer scenarios that emit shipment_status_changed webhooks must capture shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via find_shipment or test binding capture) before emitting.
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: Contract must include at least one end-to-end scenario covering paid order → shipment creation → status webhooks → consumer order update.
  owner: provider
- id: D26
  text: The consumer must ensure a valid UK postcode is provided in receiver.address.postcode for every create_shipment request; otherwise Parcelly rejects with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: consumer
- id: D27
  text: Parcel shipments via create_shipment are limited to weight_g <= 25000; heavier shipments must use create_pallet with service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000.
  owner: consumer
- id: D28
  text: The consumer's webhook handlers must capture the shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via expect_received capture) to reference in subsequent webhook emissions.
  owner: consumer
- id: D29
  text: The consumer's address parsing must map the free-text address_line to Parcelly's Address schema fields (street, building, flat, postcode, city, country) such that building is a building identifier and flat is the unit/flat number.
  owner: consumer

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 14
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  shipment: A parcel or pallet delivery created by a partner order reference
  parcel: Standard courier parcel (service=parcel) with weight up to 25 kg and size A/B/C
  pallet: Euro pallet shipment (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR) weighing 25.001–1000 kg
  tracking_number: 'Carrier tracking code: PCL<n>GB for parcels, PAL<n>GB for pallets'
  price_pence: Shipment price in pence (integer, 100 pence = £1)
  idempotency_key: Header value (max 255 chars) that makes shipment creation idempotent; blank or absent creates a new shipment
  webhook_secret: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads; header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreateShipmentRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            flat: '3'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      idempotent_on_header: Idempotency-Key
  find_shipment:
    description: Most recent shipment with a reference
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: IN_TRANSIT
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T11:00:00.000Z'
  get_shipment:
    description: One shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments/{id}
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: DELIVERED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z'
  create_pallet:
    description: Create a pallet shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/pallets
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreatePalletRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: plt_1
        service: pallet
        reference: ORD-1002
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PAL1GB
        price_pence: 8900
        receiver:
          name: Emma Brown
          phone: '+447700900300'
          address:
            street: Corn Street
            building: '1'
            postcode: BS1 1HQ
            city: Bristol
            country: GB
        pallet:
          weight_g: 27000
          pallet_type: EUR
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      idempotent_on_header: Idempotency-Key
  register_webhook:
    description: Register or replace the partner's webhook endpoint
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/webhooks
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookRegistration'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookEndpoint'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        url: https://shop.example.com/parcelly/webhook
        events:
        - shipment.status_changed
webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  parcelly_status_to_spokes_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    DELIVERED: delivered
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: Parcel weight must not exceed 25000 g; heavier parcels are rejected with 422 WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight must be between 25001 g and 1000000 g inclusive; outside this range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight band: A ≤ 5000 g, B = 5001–15000 g, C = 15001–25000 g; mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (E.164 UK mobile); other formats return 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Address country must be GB; any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Postcode must match UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ and its outward code must match the city; mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Idempotency-Key header is optional (max 255 chars); when provided, repeated key with same payload returns the original shipment (201) with Idempotent-Replayed: true; blank or missing key always creates a new shipment.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Webhook event shipment.status_changed is emitted on every status change (CREATED→COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED→RETURNED) with occurred_at in ISO 8601 UTC; payload includes event, shipment_id, reference, status, occurred_at.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}; consumer must verify and respond 2xx for valid, 401 for invalid/missing signature.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: 'Unknown fields in request body are rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST (additionalProperties: false on all request schemas).'
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Missing or invalid Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Shipment status values are exactly CREATED, COLLECTED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED; no other statuses exist.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers as raw customer input (e.g. '07700 900200', '+447700900200', '0044 7700-900200'). The consumer will normalize to E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX before sending to Parcelly.
  owner: consumer
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores the whole delivery address in one free-text field 'address_line' (UK postcode last after city). The consumer will parse it into Parcelly's structured address (street, building, postcode, city, country=GB). Incomplete addresses (missing building/postcode) will be sent as-is; Parcelly's warehouse calls the customer before shipping.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes order weight_kg is a float (sum of unit_weight_kg × quantity, 3 decimals). The consumer will convert to parcel weight_g (int grams, rounded) and choose size band: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001–15000g, C 15001–25000g. Orders over 25 kg (e.g. cargo bikes) never fit standard parcels; the consumer will not call create_shipment for them (manual warehouse process).'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Idempotency: Spokes ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS are called on every payment confirmation (gateways may retry). The consumer will use the Spokes order_id (format ORD-<number>) as the Idempotency-Key when calling create_shipment. This ensures repeated payment confirmations for the same order produce only one shipment.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: Spokes order items (sku, name, quantity, unit_price_pence) are not sent to Parcelly; Parcelly's shipment API has no items field. The consumer keeps items only in Spokes for order management and invoicing.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "Cargo bikes (e.g. Spokes Haul 2 at 27 kg, 31.5 kg with front rack) exceed the 25 kg parcel limit. The internal rule says they 'never fit standard courier parcels' and warehouse handles them manually. Should the integration simply skip create_shipment for orders where total weight_kg > 25, leaving them for manual warehouse processing? Answer: Skip create_shipment for weight_kg > 25; order stays paid, warehouse handles manually"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "Spokes address_line is a single free-text field. Parsing it into street/building/postcode/city reliably is hard (examples: 'Flat 3, 5 Long Street, London E1 6AN', 'Unit 5, 84-92 Oxford Street, London W1D 1BS', 'Behind the old mill, London'). What parsing strategy should the consumer use? Answer: Best-effort regex: extract UK postcode (last), city (before postcode), rest as street; building/flat from known patterns (Flat X, Unit X, Apt X). Send what we parse; Parcelly warehouse calls customer if incomplete."
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D18
  text: Parcel shipments require a valid UK postcode in the receiver address; requests without a matching postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D19
  text: Parcel shipments are limited to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier orders must use the pallet service (create_pallet) with weight_g 25001–1000000 and pallet_type=EUR.
  owner: provider
- id: H3
  text: "Redacted: request for clarification on postcode requirement Answer: Consumer fixes S3: add a valid postcode to the address_line (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London E1 6AN') and expect 201"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: 'Redacted: request for clarification on weight limit handling Answer: Consumer changes S2 weight_kg to ≤25 (e.g., 1.5) for parcel idempotency test'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D20
  text: Parcelly Address schema requires postcode with UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; requests without a valid postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D21
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D22
  text: Receiver address must include a postcode matching UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; Parcelly rejects requests without it with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D23
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D24
  text: Consumer scenarios that emit shipment_status_changed webhooks must capture shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via find_shipment or test binding capture) before emitting.
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: Contract must include at least one end-to-end scenario covering paid order → shipment creation → status webhooks → consumer order update.
  owner: provider
- id: D26
  text: The consumer must ensure a valid UK postcode is provided in receiver.address.postcode for every create_shipment request; otherwise Parcelly rejects with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: consumer
- id: D27
  text: Parcel shipments via create_shipment are limited to weight_g <= 25000; heavier shipments must use create_pallet with service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000.
  owner: consumer
- id: D28
  text: The consumer's webhook handlers must capture the shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via expect_received capture) to reference in subsequent webhook emissions.
  owner: consumer
- id: D29
  text: The consumer's address parsing must map the free-text address_line to Parcelly's Address schema fields (street, building, flat, postcode, city, country) such that building is a building identifier and flat is the unit/flat number.
  owner: consumer

      party: provider
      action: advance_shipment_by_reference
      args:
        reference: '{{ctx.order_id}}'
        to: DELIVERED
  - expect_state:
      party: consumer
      query: order
      args:
        order_id: '{{ctx.order_id}}'
      match:
        status: delivered
      eventually:
        timeout_s: 10
        interval_s: 0.5

    COLLECTED: shipped

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: Parcel weight must not exceed 25000 g; heavier parcels are rejected with 422 WEIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight must be between 25001 g and 1000000 g inclusive; outside this range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight band: A ≤ 5000 g, B = 5001–15000 g, C = 15001–25000 g; mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (E.164 UK mobile); other formats return 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Address country must be GB; any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Postcode must match UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ and its outward code must match the city; mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Idempotency-Key header is optional (max 255 chars); when provided, repeated key with same payload returns the original shipment (201) with Idempotent-Replayed: true; blank or missing key always creates a new shipment.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Webhook event shipment.status_changed is emitted on every status change (CREATED→COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED→RETURNED) with occurred_at in ISO 8601 UTC; payload includes event, shipment_id, reference, status, occurred_at.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}; consumer must verify and respond 2xx for valid, 401 for invalid/missing signature.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: 'Unknown fields in request body are rejected with 400 INVALID_REQUEST (additionalProperties: false on all request schemas).'
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Missing or invalid Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Shipment status values are exactly CREATED, COLLECTED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RETURNED; no other statuses exist.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers as raw customer input (e.g. '07700 900200', '+447700900200', '0044 7700-900200'). The consumer will normalize to E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX before sending to Parcelly.
  owner: consumer
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores the whole delivery address in one free-text field 'address_line' (UK postcode last after city). The consumer will parse it into Parcelly's structured address (street, building, postcode, city, country=GB). Incomplete addresses (missing building/postcode) will be sent as-is; Parcelly's warehouse calls the customer before shipping.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes order weight_kg is a float (sum of unit_weight_kg × quantity, 3 decimals). The consumer will convert to parcel weight_g (int grams, rounded) and choose size band: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001–15000g, C 15001–25000g. Orders over 25 kg (e.g. cargo bikes) never fit standard parcels; the consumer will not call create_shipment for them (manual warehouse process).'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Idempotency: Spokes ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS are called on every payment confirmation (gateways may retry). The consumer will use the Spokes order_id (format ORD-<number>) as the Idempotency-Key when calling create_shipment. This ensures repeated payment confirmations for the same order produce only one shipment.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: Spokes order items (sku, name, quantity, unit_price_pence) are not sent to Parcelly; Parcelly's shipment API has no items field. The consumer keeps items only in Spokes for order management and invoicing.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "Cargo bikes (e.g. Spokes Haul 2 at 27 kg, 31.5 kg with front rack) exceed the 25 kg parcel limit. The internal rule says they 'never fit standard courier parcels' and warehouse handles them manually. Should the integration simply skip create_shipment for orders where total weight_kg > 25, leaving them for manual warehouse processing? Answer: Skip create_shipment for weight_kg > 25; order stays paid, warehouse handles manually"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "Spokes address_line is a single free-text field. Parsing it into street/building/postcode/city reliably is hard (examples: 'Flat 3, 5 Long Street, London E1 6AN', 'Unit 5, 84-92 Oxford Street, London W1D 1BS', 'Behind the old mill, London'). What parsing strategy should the consumer use? Answer: Best-effort regex: extract UK postcode (last), city (before postcode), rest as street; building/flat from known patterns (Flat X, Unit X, Apt X). Send what we parse; Parcelly warehouse calls customer if incomplete."
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D18
  text: Parcel shipments require a valid UK postcode in the receiver address; requests without a matching postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D19
  text: Parcel shipments are limited to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier orders must use the pallet service (create_pallet) with weight_g 25001–1000000 and pallet_type=EUR.
  owner: provider
- id: H3
  text: "Redacted: request for clarification on postcode requirement Answer: Consumer fixes S3: add a valid postcode to the address_line (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London E1 6AN') and expect 201"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: 'Redacted: request for clarification on weight limit handling Answer: Consumer changes S2 weight_kg to ≤25 (e.g., 1.5) for parcel idempotency test'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D20
  text: Parcelly Address schema requires postcode with UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; requests without a valid postcode are rejected with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D21
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D22
  text: Receiver address must include a postcode matching UK pattern ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$; Parcelly rejects requests without it with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D23
  text: Parcel service (create_shipment) accepts weight_g up to 25000 g (25 kg). Heavier shipments must use create_pallet (service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000).
  owner: provider
- id: D24
  text: Consumer scenarios that emit shipment_status_changed webhooks must capture shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via find_shipment or test binding capture) before emitting.
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: Contract must include at least one end-to-end scenario covering paid order → shipment creation → status webhooks → consumer order update.
  owner: provider
- id: D26
  text: The consumer must ensure a valid UK postcode is provided in receiver.address.postcode for every create_shipment request; otherwise Parcelly rejects with 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: consumer
- id: D27
  text: Parcel shipments via create_shipment are limited to weight_g <= 25000; heavier shipments must use create_pallet with service=pallet, pallet_type=EUR, weight_g 25001–1000000.
  owner: consumer
- id: D28
  text: The consumer's webhook handlers must capture the shipment_id from the create_shipment response (via expect_received capture) to reference in subsequent webhook emissions.
  owner: consumer
- id: D29
  text: The consumer's address parsing must map the free-text address_line to Parcelly's Address schema fields (street, building, flat, postcode, city, country) such that building is a building identifier and flat is the unit/flat number.
  owner: consumer
